notes.after: The source identifies strain FN0603 as Enterobacter hormaechei by 16S rRNA V5-V7 sequencing. Separately, the pinned kg-microbe NCBI2GTDB.tsv.gz reference correspondence (SHA-256 761d5537a7edb4b0133e88e7bbc85570cf3cb6f2555b9f9ce6cca3e1056a0ddd) has no exact NCBITaxon:158836 row; its native ncbi_name route returns Enterobacter hoffmannii, E. hormaechei and E. hormaechei_B for this species descriptor. notes.before: The source identifies strain FWP1205 as Enterobacter ludwigii by 16S rRNA sequencing; no species-level GTDB classification is asserted here.
notes.after: The source identifies strain FWP1205 as Enterobacter ludwigii by 16S rRNA V5-V7 sequencing. Separately, the pinned kg-microbe NCBI2GTDB.tsv.gz reference correspondence (SHA-256 761d5537a7edb4b0133e88e7bbc85570cf3cb6f2555b9f9ce6cca3e1056a0ddd) resolves the exact NCBITaxon:299767 descriptor row to GTDB Enterobacter ludwigii, with 296 reference genomes and stored majority fraction 0.95. This is a reference-population correspondence, not 296 genomes from FWP1205 and not an assembly-grounded GTDB classification of that study stock. The crosswalk's GTDB release is not established; the primary 16S identification and stock name are preserved.
